strict_scale_note: SCENARIO_TOO_SMALL for large_system_strict without padding. Natural close engine plus 12k seed is the authentic surface; cloning extra HR modules would only inflate LOC.

root_cause_clusters.RC1_EFFECTIVE_DATED: Close reads assignment as of period start, so mid-cycle transfers do not move FLSA, leave, or cost center.
root_cause_clusters.RC2_FLSA_OT: Overtime math always uses non-exempt 1.5x, including exempt salary heads.
root_cause_clusters.RC3_CUTOFF: Punches after payroll cutoff_at are included in hours.
root_cause_clusters.RC4_DOUBLE_CLOSE: A second close appends register lines instead of failing closed.
root_cause_clusters.RC5_LEAVE_EXC: Leave accrual is not day-prorated and missing_out still counts hours.
root_cause_clusters.RC6_IDP: Local fake IdP token is not validated.
